description: Set up a Cilium Cluster Mesh with Multi-Cluster Services (MCS-API) between two Kubernetes clusters and deploy one independent YugabyteDB universe per cluster with the yugabyte Helm chart, so the universes can be joined with xCluster replication (source -> target / DR). Covers kind cluster configs with non-overlapping CIDRs, cilium install with clustermesh.mcsapi, clustermesh enable/connect, Helm values (multicluster.createServiceExports, kubernetesClusterId, masterAddresses, totalMasters), svc.clusterset.local DNS checks, and yb-admin xCluster setup. Use when the user mentions Cilium Cluster Mesh with YugabyteDB, xCluster on Kubernetes across clusters, cross-cluster YugabyteDB on kind, ServiceExport/ServiceImport for yb-masters or yb-tservers, or clusterset.local addresses for YugabyteDB. Does NOT cover the YugabyteDB Kubernetes Operator or YBA-managed DR (use yb-k8s-operator), or a single universe stretched across clusters.
